# Sitemap Discovery Scaling Delta

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

The Awtsmoos revealed one hidden ceiling beneath the public discovery doorway;
Awtsmoos.com must not mistake a UI-sized window for the whole public city when a complete map is the mission of the day.

## Plan delta

The earlier sitemap plan proposed paging `/api/social/heichelos/discover`. Archaeology showed that `heichelDiscover()` truncates its no-query candidate scan to the first 500 Heichel IDs before API pagination. Paging that response therefore cannot reveal public Heichelos beyond candidate 500.

The canonical internals already expose a better complete path:

- `allHeichelDiscoveryIds($i)` gathers indexed and physical Heichel IDs without the UI scan cap.
- `discoveryItem($i, heichelId, environment)` applies the same publication and discoverability policy used by the public discovery endpoint.

## Improved implementation

The dynamic Heichel sitemap index will use `allHeichelDiscoveryIds()` and filter each candidate through `discoveryItem()` with the default public environment policy.

This does not duplicate privacy rules. It reuses the same canonical policy while removing only the presentation-layer 500-item ceiling.

A bounded batch size will prevent unbounded simultaneous database reads. IDs will be deduplicated and sorted before XML rendering so the sitemap remains deterministic.
